predictions.quote: That means that the majority of the world, think of it as the belt and road initiative, are going to use Chinese models and not American models.
predictions.prediction: Because China is pursuing open-weight, open-training-data AI models while the US focuses on closed models, most of the world (particularly Belt-and-Road-aligned countries) will end up using Chinese AI models rather than American ones.

predictions.quote: It's going to be a long time before humanoid robots... Be a very long time before we see that. Uh what you're going to see is very very fast mobility solutions, right? airly airbased solutions and also hypersonics.
predictions.prediction: Humanoid robots (like Optimus) will not become a significant factor in warfare for a long time; instead, near-term military robotics gains will come from fast air-based, underwater, and hypersonic mobility systems.

predictions.quote: I don't agree with the three years but I do agree that it'll be maybe six or seven years.
predictions.prediction: Savant-level AI superintelligence (domain-specific genius-level capability, e.g. a 'physics savant' or 'math savant') will arrive in roughly six to seven years, not the three years some in Silicon Valley predict.

predictions.quote: I've funded a number of startups which claim to be close to it, but of course these are startups and you never know, which tells me it's 5 10 years cutting numbers.
predictions.prediction: AI systems achieving recursive self-improvement (a key milestone toward AGI) are roughly 5 to 10 years away.
